# BoltOdds

> BoltOdds is a real-time sports betting odds API. One WebSocket connection streams normalized odds from 40+ sportsbooks, exchanges and prediction markets (main lines, alternate lines and player props, pregame and live), plus live scores and play-by-play data. It is built for developers, bettors and companies building betting models, odds screens, arbitrage and +EV tools.

## What it provides

- Real-time odds over WebSocket (`wss://spro.agency/api`): changes are pushed as individual `line_update` messages in one consistent JSON format across every book, so the same code works for all of them.
- Coverage: main markets (moneylines, spreads, totals), alternate spreads and totals, and player props, pregame and in-game.
- Snapshot endpoint (`GET /api/snapshot`) for the full current state of your subscription, then deltas over the WebSocket.
- Filters by sportsbook, league, game and market.
- Deep links to the sportsbook bet slip on supported books.
- Live scores and play-by-play feeds, including 20 frames-per-second ball and player tracking for the NBA and soccer.
- Parlay pricing engine and parlay deep links.

## Sportsbooks, exchanges and prediction markets

DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, Bet365, Fanatics, Hard Rock Bet, BetRivers, theScore Bet, Circa Sports, BookMaker, JustBet, Betcris, Bovada, BetOnline, LowVig, SportsBetting.ag, Stake, Bet105, Bet99, Sports Interaction, bwin, PartySports, LeoVegas, NorthStar Bets, 888sport, Bally Bet, PlayNow, Mise-o-jeu, Play Fallsview, PokerStars, TonyBet, Neobet, Ozoon, Thunderpick, Kalshi, Polymarket, ProphetX, NoVig, DraftKings Predictions, FanDuel Predicts, and a sharp consensus line (Pro plan).

## Sports and leagues

NFL, NCAAF, CFL, NBA, WNBA, NCAAB, EuroLeague and international basketball, NHL, college and European hockey, MLB, NPB, KBO, EPL, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Champions League, Europa League, MLS, Liga MX and other soccer leagues, tennis, table tennis, UFC, boxing, golf, Formula 1, NASCAR, IndyCar and esports (CS2, League of Legends, Dota 2, Valorant, Call of Duty, Rainbow Six, Overwatch, Rocket League).

## Plans

- Starter: 1 league and 1 market per connection, 1 connection.
- Growth: up to 3 leagues per connection, all markets, 1 connection.
- Pro: all leagues, all markets, all sportsbooks, 3 concurrent connections.
- Enterprise / custom plans available.
- Free trial: 3 days, no credit card required.
- Plans start at $119/month billed annually. Current pricing: https://boltodds.com/pricing
